Hi Samira,

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. As discussed, we should run a focused 60-minute deep-dive with our architecture and infra folks to cover: VPC peering options, private link patterns, KV cache persistence, and air‑gapped restore procedures. Goal is to come away with a short mutual action plan and a connectivity checklist for your security team.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu May 24, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Fri May 25, 09:00–10:00 PT

Can you confirm which works for you and who from HealthGrid will join (network/security/devops)? I’ve penciled in Monica (Eng, solutions) and Stephanie (Field infra) on our side.

If helpful, I can share a 1‑page pre-read (connectivity matrix + checklist) before the call.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Thanks, this looks good. HealthGrid attendees: me (Head of IT), Ida Park (Network Lead), and one of our security architects (TBD). 1) Can you share the checklist / connectivity matrix ahead of time so our security architect can scan for obvious blocking items?
2) We have a current network topology file (attached) — would you like that in advance?

If you can do Thu May 24 at 12:00 PM PT that would be ideal; otherwise Fri May 25 at 9:00 AM PT also works but Ida may have limited availability then.

Samira —

Thanks for the note and for the topology file — that’s helpful. We can do Thu May 24 at 12:00 PM PT (3:00 PM ET). I’ve asked Stephanie to prepare the 1‑page connectivity matrix and our 2‑page on‑prem checklist (airgap considerations, KMS/HSM touchpoints, restore SOP).

Stephanie / Monica — can you attach the checklist and the connectivity matrix template in reply here so Samira’s team can start populating? Also, please add a short agenda (30 min technical + 20 min action items) and a calendar invite with a dial‑in and EXPLICIT notes about no public outbound traffic for air‑gapped items.

Samira — will Ida and your security architect be able to share any firewall/IP allowlist constraints ahead of time? That will speed the call.

Thanks,
Ben
